Splitting into 9 separate vaults requires a separate funded zenith account and a separate escrow deposit for each, which means the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence since the mirror binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. Each impostor pays 5 dollars up front. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
